snippet.title: Crime Shop Simulator | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Prison Boss Prohibition, the sequel to Prison Boss VR, the best toilet wine simulator ever made , is releasing on July 10th 2025 on Meta Quest and Steam.

Pre-orders are now open on Meta Quest with a 15% discount and exclusive cosmetics!

Meta Quest: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/prison-boss-prohibition/6710396435653866/
Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2973830/Prison_Boss_Prohibition/
Discord: https://discord.gg/prisonboss
